rotowire.headline: Kessler registered 13 points (6-9 FG, 1-4 FT), eight rebounds, two blocks and one steal over 33 minutes during Tuesday's 136-129 loss to the Trail Blazers.
rotowire.story: Kessler was solid in the loss, scoring on six of nine shots over 33 minutes. The center's free-throw shooting was an issue again, but his rim protection remains key to the Lakers' starting lineup. He'll face a tough frontcourt test Wednesday against the Clippers.
rotowire.description: Kessler registered 13 points (6-9 FG, 1-4 FT), eight rebounds, two blocks and one steal over 33 minutes during Tuesday's 136-129 loss to the Trail Blazers.

fantasy.projection: Kessler was limited by shoulder surgery to only five games last season but should be returned to health for this, his first campaign with the Lakers. Kessler has been brought in to be the Lakers' franchise big man: an anchor on defense and a finisher on offense. Kessler is one of the best shot-blockers in the NBA and an athletic finisher around the rim, exactly the prototype for the type of big that thrives next to Luka Doncic. If he stays healthy, Kessler should be poised for the best season of his career with top-50 upside in points leagues and top-30 in categories.
